# Inmobiliaria Grande

Inmobiliaria Grande is a real-estate agency in Granada, Spain, operating since 1970.
This is its static marketing website, listing homes for sale in Granada capital and
province (Monachil, Pulianas, La Malahá and Cogollos de la Vega).

Key facts:
- Address: Calle Recogidas 13, 1.º A, 18005 Granada
- Phone: +34 958 25 24 61
- WhatsApp / mobile (Javier Corpas): +34 664 678 249
- Email: info@inmobiliariagrande.com
- Founded: 1970

Main pages:
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/index.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/inmuebles.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/vende-tu-casa.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/sobre-nosotros.html
- https://www.inmobiliariagrande.com/contacto.html

The site is plain HTML + CSS + a small vanilla JS file, with no frameworks.
